caption: The drawing shows a large square piece of white or off-white paper with a smaller square centered within it, filled with a repeating geometric pattern. The inner square is predominantly red and features an evenly spaced, repeating design of small diamond shapes, each consisting of white and dark accents (possibly black or dark green) with tiny white dots in the center of each diamond. The diamonds are aligned in rows and columns, covering the entire red area. The border of the inner square is straight and clean, contrasting with the blank space around it. There are some brownish stains and marks on the white background, particularly concentrated on the upper right corner. Toward the lower right under the patterned square, the name "P.J. Jenner" is written in red ink.
